steps: Replay via MCP conkay_solve {solver_id: math.geometry-comp, typed inputs from the reference case} (or solve.direct once SC-00 lands): the unit cube's 8 vertices plus its center point, target convex-hull-3d → PASS with volume 1, surfaceArea 6, exactly 8 hull vertices, containmentVerified true; the square-plus-center set, target delaunay → 4 triangles with emptyCircleVerified true — closed-form values from the definitions, never from the solver's output.

Verification-discipline leg: a hull is served only after every input point is checked inside or on every facet, and a triangulation only after every triangle's circumcircle is checked empty of the other points (orientation predicates at 1e-12, verification gates at 1e-9); a violated gate returns FAIL with the violation measured, never a quietly served answer. Classification legs: collinear 2D inputs return the segment hull labelled degenerate rather than dressed as a polygon; point-in-polygon returns boundary as its own verdict beside inside/outside; segment-intersection classifies proper crossing, endpoint touching, and collinear overlap distinctly.

Engine-tier leg: targets boolean and point-in-solid → NOT_COMPUTED naming the OCC engine tier (SXE-01) as their scope — refused by name, never approximated in JS; with the engine absent the engine path shows NOT_COMPUTED engine_unavailable:sxe-01 with install hint, never a fallback number labelled as the engine result; engine crash/timeout/non-convergence → engine_failed / engine_not_converged.

Adversarial: NaN / 1e300 / negative-where-physical-positive input → INVALID_INPUT with the field named; a missing required property → NOT_COMPUTED naming the field, with no assumed value unless declared and echoed as defaulted (SC-03); a substituted input → NOT_COMPUTED input_substituted (inputs used == inputs submitted); beyond the declared caps (2D sets 20,000 points; 3D hull and Delaunay 2,000; closest-pair 5,000) → NOT_COMPUTED naming the violated bound and the Qhull-scale engine tier; a bare number on a dimensional input → refused unless the unit is declared (SC-04 leg, expected-fail until built).
